card.name: Words just before a purpose or continuation
card.fires_on: Small linking words, mostly "to" meaning "in order to", right after a noun or verb in explanatory web text. Also fires on "be", "also", and a closing parenthesis inside a list.

modes.label: Purpose "to"
modes.description: The word "to" introduces a purpose clause such as "to determine" or "to check".
modes.example: (one is not able to count 'teeth'<< to>> determine gear ratio)

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: Short words like "be" or "also" that sit before a verb or phrase continuing the sentence.
modes.example: a perfect example of masking can<< be>> found at about 0:15

modes.label: Closing bracket after number
modes.description: A closing parenthesis ends a list of numbers inside an explanation.
modes.example: The first number (10, 100, 1000<<)>> indicates the transmission speed in megabits

card.writes: Little clear effect; it promotes odd Chinese and fragment tokens and suppresses ellipsis and "Consequently" tokens.
card.plain: It marks small linking words, mainly "to" meaning "in order to", where a sentence is about to continue.
